svg.text: An LLM agent discovers features, evaluates them, and shows their effect on the cases you care about; every result is logged and reshapes which ideas come next. People set the direction and decide at the gates.

g.text: sets the direction, in plain words
one LLM agent · acts only through tools · discovery → evaluation → inference, all logged on one board
ideas → features or data requests → checks
L1 / L2 · BUILD A FEATURE FROM DATA WE ALREADY HAVE
✓ verified → goes on to evaluation ✗ failed → logged with the check and the reason
L3 · ASK FOR DATA WE DON'T HAVE YET
✓ kept → validated SQL, ready to pull
✗ dropped → logged: current data covers it
pulled data becomes a new source → L1/L2 features from it next round
👤 analyst picks which verified features to evaluate
1 · rebuild on the full splits — 🔒 hidden from the agent
2 · retrain base vs base + new, alone and combined
3 · read out on the out-of-time test
🎯 one target case · a high-balance customer who defaulted
re-score the case after each transaction: base vs base + new
👤 analyst sees: does the new model react earlier?
each target case: its score path,
base vs new · how much earlier
every check, screen and challenge result — pass or fail
updates each idea's P(useful) → the next draw
🎯 target cases, re-scored by base vs base + new
one row per feature or data request · written from the run's own records, never from the agent's account
Illustrative rows. Each outcome updates its idea's P(useful) — the distribution the next idea is drawn from. A script that fails to run says nothing about the idea, so it counts neither way.
